content.content:
# Fax Processing - Operations

Live Application Insights telemetry. Business facts are safe, sampled operational signals and must be reconciled to immutable job/manifests for official counts. No fax text or extracted values are displayed.

content.query:
AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| summarize Requests=count(), Failed=countif(Success == false), P50DurationMs=round(percentile(DurationMs, 50), 1), P95DurationMs=round(percentile(DurationMs, 95), 1)

AppRequests
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| summarize Requests=count(), Failed=countif(Success == false) by bin(TimeGenerated, 15m)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

let Latest = AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where Message startswith "FAX_METRIC "
| extend Fact=parse_json(substring(Message, 11))
| extend FaxId=tostring(Fact.faxId), Status=tostring(Fact.status)
| where isnotempty(FaxId)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by FaxId;
Latest
| summarize Faxes=count() by Status
| order by Faxes desc

let Latest = AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where Message startswith "FAX_METRIC "
| extend Fact=parse_json(substring(Message, 11))
| extend FaxId=tostring(Fact.faxId), Status=tostring(Fact.status), ReviewEnteredAt=todatetime(Fact.reviewEnteredAt), Source=tostring(Fact.sourceLabel), DocumentType=tostring(Fact.documentType), Reason=tostring(Fact.reason)
| where isnotempty(FaxId)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by FaxId;
Latest
| where Status == "PendingHumanReview"
| extend AgeHours=round(datetime_diff("minute", now(), ReviewEnteredAt) / 60.0, 1)
| project FaxId, AgeHours, Source, DocumentType, Reason
| order by AgeHours desc

AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where Message startswith "FAX_METRIC "
| extend Fact=parse_json(substring(Message, 11))
| where tostring(Fact.status) == "Completed"
| extend FaxId=tostring(Fact.faxId), Mode=tostring(Fact.completionMode), Created=todatetime(Fact.createdAt), Prepared=todatetime(Fact.updatedAt)
| where isnotempty(FaxId) and isnotnull(Created) and isnotnull(Prepared)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by FaxId
| extend LatencyMinutes=datetime_diff("second", Prepared, Created) / 60.0
| summarize Completed=count(), P50Minutes=round(percentile(LatencyMinutes, 50), 2), P95Minutes=round(percentile(LatencyMinutes, 95), 2) by Mode

AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated > ago(24h)
| where Message startswith "FAX_STAGE_FAILURE " or Message startswith "fax_"
| extend SafeCode=iff(Message startswith "FAX_STAGE_FAILURE ", tostring(parse_json(substring(Message, 18)).code), tostring(split(Message, " ")[0]))
| summarize Count=count(), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated) by SafeCode
| order by Count desc
